sermons.title: The Finished Work of Jesus
summary: Jesus' cry 'It is finished' means the debt for sin has been paid in full.
Believers rest in what Christ accomplished, not in their own performance.
The gift of righteousness is received, not earned.

sermons.title: Rooted and Grounded in Love
summary: Receiving God's love produces inner healing and stability.
The knowledge of being loved by God transforms how we love others.
Meditate on the Father's love until it becomes your default posture.

sermons.title: Living in the Favor of God
summary: Favor is unearned goodness that follows grace-conscious believers.
Expect favor with God and with people daily.
Confess favor over your day, work, and family.
